title: Draining the Density Ratchet to Zero
description: OrchestKit #4072 set an information-density floor of 0.20 under every fenced ASCII block in the skills and carried a shrinking baseline of five allowances. #4073 asks for those blocks to be drained. This PR reworks all five above the floor by tightening the art, never by deleting a block or padding it, and empties the baseline to the schema header alone. Pick any before or after block and watch the exact gate arithmetic run live; drive the allowance simulator through the real drain sequence, then try the two moves the ratchet refuses: raising an allowance back, and planting a fresh low block.
